chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:

Allāh, the Glorified, has fixed the livelihood of the destitute in the wealth of the rich. Consequently, whenever a destitute remains hungry it is because some rich person has denied (him his share). Allāh, the Sublime, will question them about it.

key_terms.فَرَضَ: obligated or fixed as a right

ai.seo_question: What is the divine right of the poor in the wealth of the rich according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates the concept of *aqwat* (basic sustenance) as a divine right embedded in the wealth of the affluent, transforming charity from mere generosity into a mandatory obligation. This narration underscores the social justice principle that poverty is often a result of wealth hoarding, making the rich accountable for the deprivation of the poor in the Hereafter. It reflects the Shia jurisprudential view that wealth is a trust (*amanah*) with specific social liabilities.
